title: Trump Announces 3-Day Russia-Ukraine Ceasefire and 1,000-Prisoner Exchange
detail: US President Donald Trump announced on May 8 that both Russia and Ukraine had agreed to a three-day ceasefire beginning May 9, as well as an exchange of 1,000 prisoners by each side — the largest prisoner swap of the year. Trump stated: 'This request was made directly by me, and I very much appreciate its agreement by President Vladimir Putin and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Hopefully, it is the beginning of the end of a very long, deadly, and hard fought War.' Both Zelensky and Putin's foreign affairs adviser Yuri Ushakov confirmed the agreement. The ceasefire was to run May 9–11, coinciding with Russia's Victory Day commemorations.

media.caption: Trump announces 3-day ceasefire and 1,000-prisoner exchange between Russia and Ukraine

title: Russia Confirms Scaled-Down Victory Day Parade — No Tanks or Heavy Weapons
detail: For the first time in nearly two decades, Russia's Red Square Victory Day parade on May 9 was confirmed to proceed without tanks, armored vehicles, or other heavy weapons systems, with only a flyover by combat jets retained. Russian officials explained the change by reference to the 'current operational situation' and heightened security measures against possible Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow. The scaled-back format — removing the most symbolically powerful elements of the annual display — was itself a signal of the war's toll on Russia's military equipment and readiness.

media.caption: Russia's Victory Day parade stripped of tanks and missiles for first time in nearly 20 years
